set.body:
Seen in docs/gallery/composed-figure.svg while reviewing the regenerated plates for bd-01M20KHQ11W425M83J49GS0JFH; present identically before that change (main 255369d), so it is independent of it.

The right-hand cell's y axis labels render as '.5' where the markup holds '3.5' and '4.5': the SVG emits the full strings, right-anchored at x=252.4009, and Chromium 141 shows only the fractional part. The leading digit falls outside the cell's clip, so the cell's left axis strip is narrower than its widest tick label, or the cell clip excludes the axis strip.

Acceptance: a composed figure's cell reserves its own widest tick label (measured with the actual labels, including fractional ticks) and no cell clip cuts its axis text; verify from independent SVG text bounds against the cell clip and a rendered plate, on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Composed figure clips the leading digits of a cell's y tick labels
